fields.meta_description: Build a DJ booking form that checks your open dates and hands the DJ the timeline and load-in details for every gig.
fields.h1: Build a DJ Booking Form for Every Gig on Your Calendar
fields.hero_description: Build a DJ booking form that offers only your open dates and saves each gig's timeline to a database you own.
fields.features_heading: What the DJ Knows Before Load-In
fields.features_subheading: The first dance time should never be news at the venue. The form gathers the timeline and load-in notes as the client books.
fields.feature_1:
Booked dates drop off the calendar

The date picker checks your gig calendar and offers only dates with no booking yet. A Saturday you already hold stays off the list until that gig is canceled or moved.
fields.feature_2:
A timeline from setup to last song

Ask for the setup time, the start, and the end, then the moments in between, like the grand entrance, toasts, and the first dance. The DJ reads them in order on one sheet.
fields.feature_3:
Music notes the client writes once

Give the client room for must-play songs, a do-not-play list, and genres to avoid. A school booking can require clean edits, and that rule sits at the top of the DJ's sheet.
fields.feature_4:
Venue details for load-in

Collect the venue address, the load-in time, where to park, and how far the DJ table sits from power. Add the venue coordinator's phone number for the day of the event.
fields.feature_5:
New inquiries reach the right DJ

Email each new inquiry to the DJ who is free that night, or post it to a Slack channel for the office. A company with several DJs can split inquiries by date or event type.
fields.feature_6:
Your booking app's code, on GitHub

On paid plans, export the full codebase to your GitHub repository and keep building. Every booking stays in a database you own, with no cap on how many inquiries come in.

fields.usecase_heading: Who Books the DJ, and What the DJ Gets
fields.tab_content_1:
From ceremony to last song, Bertrand has the timeline

Tannery Lane DJs asks every couple for the times that shape the night. Briony Quennevaux and Lazlo Mikkelsen book Saturday, June 12, 2027, at Saltmarrow Barn and fill in a 4:30 PM ceremony and a 7:15 PM first dance. DJ Bertrand Quartermaine gets the timeline by email, ending with the last song at 11:00 PM.
fields.tab_content_2:
A 3:45 PM load-in and 2 mics on Folasade's sheet

Corporate parties at Quillstone Events start with a load-in time and a mic count. Ploverdale Freight books a hotel ballroom party for Friday, December 10, 2027, and asks for 2 wireless mics for speeches. DJ Folasade Blackwood-Teague gets a load-in sheet with the 3:45 PM arrival and the dock to use.
fields.tab_content_3:
School dances come in flagged for clean edits

Pinwheel Sound treats any school booking as clean edits only, and the form says so. Ridgemoss Middle School books its spring dance on Friday, May 14, 2027, for grades 6 to 8, ending at 9:00 PM. The school adds 4 songs to the do-not-play list, and DJ Emrys Talbot sees the clean edits rule above them.
fields.tab_content_4:
Only Cordelia is free when 3 of 4 DJs are booked

Four DJs work for Murrelton Entertainment, and the form checks each calendar against the date a client asks for. Isadora Szabo-Lind asks for Saturday, October 9, 2027, when 3 of the 4 are booked. Her inquiry goes by email to Cordelia Varnet, the one DJ still open. Once all 4 are booked, the date leaves the picker.

fields.howto_title: How to Create a DJ Booking Form
fields.howto_description: Seven steps to create a DJ booking form that hides dates you already hold and gives the DJ what each gig needs.
fields.howto_step_1_title: 01 Write down what you ask on the phone
fields.howto_step_2_title: 02 Put the date and venue first
fields.howto_step_3_title: 03 Ask different questions by event type
fields.howto_step_1_des: List the questions you ask every client on an inquiry call: the date, the venue, the start and end times, and the event type. Add the guest count if it changes your setup. Each answer you need before you quote becomes a field.
fields.howto_step_2_des: Open the form with the event date, since a date you already hold ends the conversation. Connect the date picker to your gig calendar so it offers only open dates. Ask for the venue name and address right after it.
fields.howto_step_3_des: Show a couple the ceremony, dinner, and first dance times to fill in. Show a corporate client the speech times and a mic count instead. Keep each branch short enough that a client can finish it on a phone.
fields.howto_step_4_des: Choose where a new inquiry goes before you share the form. A solo DJ can take an email for every one. With a team, route by date or event type, such as weddings to one DJ and school dances to another.
fields.howto_step_5_des: Tell the client what happens next, both on the screen after they submit and in the email that follows. Say when you will reply, what the quote depends on, and when the date counts as booked on your side.
fields.howto_step_6_title: 06 Book a fake gig with a test address
fields.howto_step_6_des: Submit two test bookings for the same Saturday: a wedding first, then a school dance. Check that each shows the right questions, that the second sees the date as taken, and that each email lands with the right DJ.
fields.howto_step_7_title: 07 Share the link where clients find you
fields.howto_step_7_des: Put the form link on your website's booking page and in the signature on your email replies. Print it as a QR code on a card at the DJ table for guests who ask how to book you.

faq_plan.q: What is a DJ booking form?
faq_plan.a: A DJ booking form is how a client books a DJ for an event. Oxford Learner's Dictionaries describes a DJ as a person whose job is to introduce and play recorded popular music, including at a club or party. The form collects what that job needs: the date and venue, plus the hours and the client's music notes.

faq_plan.q: How do I create a DJ booking form?
faq_plan.a: Write down the questions you ask on an inquiry call, decide which event types get which questions, and plan how dates already booked come off the calendar. Then describe it to Emergent's AI form builder, which builds the form and the database behind it. Book a test gig before you share the link.

faq_plan.q: What fields should a DJ booking form template include?
faq_plan.a: Start with the client's name, phone, and email, then the event date, venue, start and end times, and event type. A DJ booking form template that stops there sends you back to the phone for the rest. Add the load-in time and a do-not-play list.

faq_plan.q: What venue details should a DJ booking form ask for?
faq_plan.a: Start with where the venue is, then the details that slow a setup: which entrance to use, whether an elevator reaches the room, and when the room must be clear after the last song. For a hotel ballroom, ask about the loading dock. Guests who need rooms for the night book them through a separate hotel booking form.

faq_plan.q: How can a DJ booking form avoid double-booking a date?
faq_plan.a: Tie the date picker to the gigs you have already taken, and a booked date stops showing. With Emergent, one prompt builds the form along with its calendar database. In the finished app, each new booking takes that date away from the next client.

faq_plan.q: What wedding questions belong on a DJ booking form?
faq_plan.a: Ask for the ceremony time and place, the grand entrance, dinner, toasts, the first dance, any parent dances, and the time the last song plays. Ask for the names you will announce and how to pronounce them. Leave room for songs the couple wants skipped.

faq_plan.q: Can one DJ booking form handle a company with several DJs?
faq_plan.a: Yes. Let the client request a DJ by name, and if that DJ is taken, offer the others who are free that night. Show the requested DJ's photo and a short bio next to the choice. For lessons or studio time rather than gigs, a general booking form fits better.

faq_plan.q: Should the do-not-play list go on the DJ booking form?
faq_plan.a: Yes, if you plan the set from it. Cap the list at a number you can honor, such as 10 songs, and ask for the artist and the title in separate fields. For a school event, state the clean edits rule right next to the list.

faq_plan.q: What happens after a client submits a DJ booking form?
faq_plan.a: The booking saves to your database, and the app emails the details to you or the assigned DJ, or posts them to a Slack channel. The client sees a confirmation and gets an email saying what happens next. Forms built with Emergent have no response caps, even across a busy wedding season.

faq_plan.q: Can a DJ booking form work for bar and restaurant gigs?
faq_plan.a: Yes. For a residency or a one-night set, ask for the night, the set length, the sound system the venue already has, and who to contact at the door. Keep the two forms apart: a restaurant reservation form books tables for diners, and this one books your set.
